high_alert_reason: ISMP high-alert: opioid. Respiratory depression and accidental overdose (100× more potent than morphine by weight). Requires double-check on continuous infusion and any bolus.
adult_dose: RSI analgesia/sedation: 1–3 mcg/kg IV push over 1–2 min. ICU infusion: 25–200 mcg/hr, titrate to CPOT / behavioral pain scale. Bolus for breakthrough: 25–100 mcg.
renal_adjustment: Minimal accumulation (hepatic metabolism) but prolonged context-sensitive half-life in prolonged infusion.
max_dose: No absolute ceiling in ICU infusion; escalation > 200 mcg/hr warrants reevaluation (tolerance, alternate analgesia).
indications: Transdermal chronic pain (outpatient; not for opioid-naive)
contraindications: Severe respiratory depression without ventilatory support
key_monitoring: Respiratory rate and SpO2 (when not mechanically ventilated)
Pain score (CPOT in intubated, 0–10 NRS in communicative)
Blood pressure (hypotension with rapid IV push)
Chest wall rigidity (rare but can prevent ventilation with rapid high-dose push)

provenance.source: SCCM PAD guidelines + DEA scheduling + ISMP high-alert list
